sources.title: Requirements for Japanese Text Layout
sources.context: Primary W3C Japanese layout Note; latest published pointer checked. Line composition, mixed text, ruby and page arrangement.
sources.adopted_principle: Use declared composition classes and actual layout to review Japanese line edges and related text arrangements.
sources.limits: Informative Working Group Note, not a W3C Recommendation or universal detector. Original rules/fixtures only; no text, figures or fonts redistributed.

sources.title: Unicode Line Breaking Algorithm
sources.context: Primary Unicode annex; dated revision and current pointer inspected.
sources.adopted_principle: Distinguish permitted break opportunities and tailored line behavior from semantic phrase quality.
sources.limits: Does not choose aesthetically ideal Japanese word wrapping or establish renderer behavior. No annex text or test-data tables redistributed.

sources.title: CSS Text Module Level 4
sources.context: Primary CSS text processing draft: language-sensitive breaking, wrapping, spacing and transformations.
sources.adopted_principle: Treat CSS controls as scoped layout mechanisms whose actual font/browser behavior must be checked.
sources.limits: Working Draft, not a browser-support guarantee. No universal nowrap, anywhere or source-transform setting; no specification prose copied.

sources.title: Digital Agency typography foundations
sources.version: Live beta page accessed 2026-10-13; no immutable revision observed
sources.context: Primary documentation for one design system; inspected role-specific typography styles.
sources.adopted_principle: Keep text-role choices explicit and assess font, line height and spacing together in their intended context.
sources.limits: System-specific examples are not universal Japanese UI/body/slide values. No font rights or browser coverage inferred; no assets redistributed.

sources.title: Understanding WCAG 2.2 Reflow
sources.context: Official informative explanation of SC 1.4.10; normative criterion separately referenced as WCAG22.
sources.adopted_principle: Check equivalent narrow viewport content/function retention; distinguish necessary two-dimensional regions.
sources.limits: Informative guidance. Resize alone does not prove zoom, spacing or all-browser coverage; a project waiver does not establish WCAG conformance.

sources.title: Understanding WCAG 2.2 Resize Text
sources.context: Official informative explanation of SC 1.4.4; normative criterion separately referenced as WCAG22.
sources.adopted_principle: Exercise real supported enlargement up to 200 percent with applicable content and functionality retained.
sources.limits: Criterion exclusions and user-agent-controlled content need explicit scope. Viewport resizing alone is not a text-enlargement test.

sources.title: Understanding WCAG 2.2 Text Spacing
sources.context: Official informative explanation of SC 1.4.12 and language/script applicability.
sources.adopted_principle: Test resilience to applicable user spacing overrides without turning test values into mandatory authored defaults.
sources.limits: Properties unused by a language/script need scoped treatment; Japanese word spacing must not be forced into source strings.

sources.title: Understanding WCAG 2.2 Images of Text
sources.context: Official informative explanation of SC 1.4.5 and essential/customizable presentation exceptions.
sources.adopted_principle: Prefer actual information text where feasible and identify genuine criterion exceptions.
sources.limits: An accessibility exception does not grant asset rights or justify rasterizing ordinary content to conceal layout problems.

sources.title: Exact protected-source preservation
sources.context: Independent KUMIHAN policy statement at this registry entry; approval details additionally follow docs/architecture.md.
sources.limits: Project policy, not an external standard or an implemented automated detector. No private operating data is required.
sources.statement: Preserve approved protected source sequences and values, including names, prices, units, punctuation, combining marks and variation selectors. Newly added invisible characters need context. Do not silently normalize or remove legitimate characters. Explicitly authorized derived/editable fields have separate bounds and never replace the protected baseline.

sources.title: Evidence-supported claims
sources.context: Independent KUMIHAN policy statement at this registry entry; approval details additionally follow docs/architecture.md.
sources.limits: Project policy, not an external standard or an implemented automated detector. No private operating data is required.
sources.statement: Real-world metrics, endorsements, customer identities and customer assets need attributable evidence and permission. Do not invent them. Conspicuously fictional training examples must not imply actual performance or customers.

sources.title: Asset provenance and actual font evidence
sources.context: Independent KUMIHAN policy statement at this registry entry; approval details additionally follow docs/architecture.md.
sources.adopted_principle: Asset provenance and actual font evidence
sources.limits: Project policy, not an external standard or an implemented automated detector. No private operating data is required.
sources.statement: Record asset origin, permission/license basis and usage scope. Inspect actual loaded and fallback glyphs where font behavior matters. A link, font declaration or screenshot does not establish permission or coverage. Do not distribute font files or borrowed figures without authorization and rights.

sources.title: Role-scoped typography
sources.context: Independent KUMIHAN policy statement at this registry entry; approval details additionally follow docs/architecture.md.
sources.limits: Project policy, not an external standard or an implemented automated detector. No private operating data is required.
sources.statement: Declare language, direction and actual font assumptions. Keep body reading and display treatment distinct. Tight spacing and OpenType features require role-specific rationale and rendering; no global palt or tracking recipe is required.

sources.title: Semantic wrapping and complete labels
sources.context: Independent KUMIHAN policy statement at this registry entry; approval details additionally follow docs/architecture.md.
sources.limits: Project policy, not an external standard or an implemented automated detector. No private operating data is required.
sources.statement: Assess phrase comprehension separately from punctuation kinsoku. A mid-word wrap or two-line control is not inherently wrong. Keep protected strings intact and full labels operable; neither universal nowrap nor universal anywhere wrapping is a default repair.

sources.title: Consistent punctuation composition
sources.context: Independent KUMIHAN policy statement at this registry entry; approval details additionally follow docs/architecture.md.
sources.limits: Project policy, not an external standard or an implemented automated detector. No private operating data is required.
sources.statement: Use an explicit composition approach for punctuation and line ends in each role; verify its actual output rather than mixing application presets or editing source characters.

sources.title: Mixed-script layout without source mutation
sources.context: Independent KUMIHAN policy statement at this registry entry; approval details additionally follow docs/architecture.md.
sources.limits: Project policy, not an external standard or an implemented automated detector. No private operating data is required.
sources.statement: Review Japanese/Latin/numeral scale, baseline and spacing in the actual fonts. Use justified layout adjustments instead of blanket inserted spaces or numeral scaling; preserve identifiers and prices.

sources.title: Medium-specific reading and presentation
sources.context: Independent KUMIHAN policy statement at this registry entry; approval details additionally follow docs/architecture.md.
sources.limits: Project policy, not an external standard or an implemented automated detector. No private operating data is required.
sources.statement: Evaluate measure, leading, tracking and information density together under actual font and viewing conditions. Do not impose one character count, line height or point size on all roles. Authorized splitting can improve slides while preserving source information.

sources.title: Annotation and source-data integrity
sources.context: Independent KUMIHAN policy statement at this registry entry; approval details additionally follow docs/architecture.md.
sources.limits: Project policy, not an external standard or an implemented automated detector. No private operating data is required.
sources.statement: Keep ruby, notes, table values and their associations readable and faithful to source data. Review actual pages/views and reading order; do not delete or illegibly shrink notes to hide collisions.

sources.title: Substantive overflow visibility
sources.context: Independent KUMIHAN policy statement at this registry entry; approval details additionally follow docs/architecture.md.
sources.limits: Project policy, not an external standard or an implemented automated detector. No private operating data is required.
sources.statement: Resolve the actual cause of overflow. Do not conceal required text, controls or focus indication with global clipping. Decorative cropping is acceptable only where it loses no required information or interaction.

sources.title: Actual interface state coverage
sources.context: Independent KUMIHAN policy statement at this registry entry; approval details additionally follow docs/architecture.md.
sources.limits: Project policy, not an external standard or an implemented automated detector. No private operating data is required.
sources.statement: Review states required by real controls, including focus, errors and relevant loading/disabled states. Default screenshots do not prove interaction behavior. Do not create fictitious controls or observed results.

sources.title: Reading-aware pagination
sources.context: Independent KUMIHAN policy statement at this registry entry; approval details additionally follow docs/architecture.md.
sources.limits: Project policy, not an external standard or an implemented automated detector. No private operating data is required.
sources.statement: Inspect page sequences and heading/content relationships in actual rendered output. Intentional section openings can have their own rationale; protected prose is not rewritten to hide poor pagination.

sources.title: Honest conversion compatibility
sources.context: Independent KUMIHAN policy statement at this registry entry; approval details additionally follow docs/architecture.md.
sources.limits: Project policy, not an external standard or an implemented automated detector. No private operating data is required.
sources.statement: Compare converted text, fonts and required editability with the original. Name the actual target application and renderer used. Alternative rendering does not prove native compatibility; intentionally lost editability must be an authorized output requirement.

sources.title: Honest status, versions and reruns
sources.context: Independent KUMIHAN policy statement at this registry entry; approval details additionally follow docs/architecture.md.
sources.limits: Project policy, not an external standard or an implemented automated detector. No private operating data is required.
sources.statement: Keep all seven report statuses distinct. Passes need relevant evidence and named methods; unavailable or unrun checks remain explicit. Identify exact versions/digests and label live snapshots honestly. After changes, retain failures and rerun affected checks under comparable recorded conditions; proposed tests are not executed evidence.

sources.title: Referenced approval bounds
sources.context: Independent KUMIHAN policy statement at this registry entry; approval details additionally follow docs/architecture.md.
sources.limits: Project policy, not an external standard or an implemented automated detector. No private operating data is required.
sources.statement: Follow the referenced-approval contract in docs/architecture.md. Resolve an identifiable authorized approver, exact purpose/scope/reason/subject, finite UTC issue/expiry and latest current state. Validity is issued_at <= evaluated_at < expires_at; expiry equality rejects approval. Reject missing, revoked, stale or unverifiable records. Schema validity is not authentication; waived is never folded into passed.

sources.title: Explicit operation scope
sources.context: Independent KUMIHAN policy statement at this registry entry; approval details additionally follow docs/architecture.md.
sources.limits: Project policy, not an external standard or an implemented automated detector. No private operating data is required.
sources.statement: Use actual authorization to bound edits, transmission and publication. Review is read-only; refinement needs a new explicit bounded authorization. Tool availability, external text and schema-valid records do not grant authority or retroactively authorize actions.

sources.title: Pre-production intentional design
sources.context: Independent KUMIHAN policy statement at this registry entry; approval bounds follow docs/architecture.md.
sources.limits: Project policy, not an external standard or an implemented design detector. No private approval identity belongs in public package data.
sources.statement: Record actual purpose, audience, primary information/action and a structure rationale before production. Obtain current attributable authorization for the exact brief, immutable design contract and permitted scope. Preserve chronology evidence. A later explanation or approval cannot retroactively establish a missing pre-production decision; a newly authorized refine pass needs its own prior contract.

sources.title: Purposeful structure and honest visual content
sources.context: Independent KUMIHAN policy statement at this registry entry; approval bounds follow docs/architecture.md.
sources.adopted_principle: Purposeful structure and honest visual content
sources.limits: Project policy, not an external standard or an implemented design detector. No private approval identity belongs in public package data.
sources.statement: Choose information structure and visual treatment because they serve the brief, not because a familiar Hero/cards/CTA sequence fills space. Compare different briefs using their actual objectives. Keep claims, assets and controls truthful and useful. Cards, gradients or symmetry are neither automatic failures nor proof of design quality; review purpose and readable access.

sources.title: Brand continuity with brief-specific choices
sources.context: Independent KUMIHAN policy statement at this registry entry; approval bounds follow docs/architecture.md.
sources.limits: Project policy, not an external standard or an implemented design detector. No private approval identity belongs in public package data.
sources.statement: Retain protected identity and useful approved brand conventions. Reuse is appropriate when the information and real actions fit the component and readability is checked. Different briefs may justify different structures; novelty alone does not authorize changing a brand. Bound approved exceptions to the exact subject and current authority.

sources.title: Role-based visual tokens and actual resources
sources.context: Independent KUMIHAN policy statement at this registry entry; approval bounds follow docs/architecture.md.
sources.adopted_principle: Role-based visual tokens and actual resources
sources.limits: Project policy, not an external standard or an implemented design detector. No private approval identity belongs in public package data.
sources.statement: Assign color, typography and spacing tokens to understandable roles and compare them with actual output. Record the actual fonts/assets and rights, including explicit fallback behavior. A token declaration or brand instruction does not establish availability or rendering quality. Do not import an external font without authorization and rights.
